rationale: Plug-in-host integration: a Windows plug-in editor renders synchronously on the DAW's UI thread, so a Fifo (vsync) swapchain blocks GetCurrentTexture on the display refresh while the DAW already composites, stalling the message pump that delivers input. Measured in REAPER: 7 frames across 8 knob sweeps, 22.9ms mean frame, ~17-43ms unaccounted acquire. The surface now requests a non-blocking present mode and the fallback follows an explicit preference order instead of taking presentModes[0], which on this adapter is Fifo and silently reinstated the block. After: 319 frames, 2.73ms mean, 0.053ms acquire. Scope is the plug-in editor surface; standalone window hosts still request vsync.
